newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ciputra Development acquires Dutch firm.
newsitem.headline: Ciputra Development acquires Dutch firm.

text.p: Indonesian property firm PT Ciputra Development said on Tuesday its subsidiary PT Citraland Adigraha had acquired a 100 percent stake in Amsterdam-based Morby Holding BV.
"It is announced that PT Citraland Adigraha, subsidiary of PT Ciputra Development, has acquired a 100 percent stake in Morby Holding BV based in Amsterdam," it said in a statement.
Ciputra said that Morby Holding, which was currently not in operation, would be renamed as Ciputra Adigraha Finance BV.
The new subsidiary will be used as a vehicle to support the financing activities of Ciputra Development and/or its subsidiaries, it said.
Ciputra did not give further details. Ciputra officials were not immediately available for details.
